units.source_text: 古歌：“夜深天黑路崎岖，且待东升月照归。

en.t: An old poem says: Deep in the night, the sky is dark and the road is rough; let us wait until the moon rises in the east and lights our way home.

units.source_text: 赚得郎君留片刻，灯前着意看英姿。”

en.t: So I contrive to keep my lord here a little longer, and by the lamp I gaze with care upon his splendid figure.
It is found in the Man'yoshu.
